post.title: What a $32,000 car really costs after tax, title and fees
post.ig:
In Texas, a $32,000 car doesn't cost $32,000.
Example at 2026 Texas rates: 6.25% sales tax = $2,000, plus $33 title, $50.75 base registration and a $225 doc fee = $2,308.75 extra, before county fees.
Texas taxes the price minus the trade-in: an $8,000 trade-in cuts the tax to $1,500.
Doc fees: California caps them at $85; Texas dealers must file with the state to charge over $225.
Sources: Texas Comptroller, Texas OCCC, Tarrant County Tax Office, CalMatters.
News and education, not financial advice.
